title: RL-Guided Temporal Localization for Dual-Channel Retrieval in Long-Horizon Agent Memory
abstract: arXiv:2610.23598v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Time-aware retrieval is crucial for long-horizon LLM agents to effectively leverage ever-growing long-term memory. Existing methods focus on lexical or semantic similarity, leading to target memories being crowded out by temporally mismatched yet semantically similar candidates. Even time-aware approaches inject temporal cues only during memory organization or answer generation, overlooking temporal constraints at the retrieval stage, where candidate selection occurs - the root cause of the displacement. Inspired by the temporal contiguity effect in human episodic memory, we propose TIDER (Temporal Interval-driven Dual-channel Evidence Retrieval), a time-aware agentic retrieval framework. Central to TIDER is a reinforcement learning (RL)-trained temporal interval locator that infers the temporal windows in which the evidence lies. translated_title: 长时程智能体记忆中基于强化学习引导的时间定位与双通道检索
translated_abstract: 时间感知检索对于长时程LLM智能体有效利用不断增长的长期记忆至关重要。现有方法侧重于词汇或语义相似度，导致目标记忆被时间上不匹配但语义相似的候选项所挤占。即使是时间感知的方法，也仅在记忆组织或答案生成阶段注入时间线索，而忽视了检索阶段的时间约束——检索阶段正是候选选择发生的环节，也是造成这种挤占现象的根本原因。受人类情景记忆中时间邻近效应的启发，我们提出了TIDER（时间区间驱动的双通道证据检索），一个时间感知的智能体检索框架。TIDER的核心是一个通过强化学习（RL）训练的时间区间定位器，用于推断证据所在的时间窗口。RL将窗口定位作为一个离散的、不可微的检索决策进行优化，并使用复合奖励机制……
tldr: 该论文提出TIDER框架，通过强化学习训练的时间区间定位器在检索阶段引入时间约束，结合双通道证据检索，解决长时程LLM智能体记忆中目标记忆被时间不匹配但语义相似的候选记忆挤占的问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes TIDER, a time-aware agentic retrieval framework that uses an RL-trained temporal interval locator to inject temporal constraints at the retrieval stage through dual-channel evidence retrieval, addressing the problem of target memories being crowded out by temporally mismatched yet semantically similar candidates in long-horizon LLM agent memory.
